classes.explanation: Late blight is caused by the oomycete pathogen Phytophthora infestans. It appears as dark, water-soaked spots on leaves that quickly enlarge and turn brown with a white fuzzy growth on undersides.
classes.explanationRw: Icyorezo cy'ubucuruzi giterwa na Phytophthora infestans. Kigaragara nk'utudomo tw'umukara ku mababi binyura vuba bikaba ibara ry'ikigina.
classes.treatment: Apply copper-based fungicide (e.g., Copper hydroxide 77% WP) at 2.5g/L immediately. Remove and destroy all affected plant parts. Spray every 7-10 days during wet weather.
classes.treatmentRw: Shyira umuti wa copper (urugero, Copper hydroxide 77% WP) ku 2.5g/L ako kanya. Kuraho no gusenya ibice byose by'igihingwa byangiritse.
classes.prevention: Use certified disease-free seeds. Practice crop rotation (3-year cycle). Ensure proper spacing (60cm between plants). Avoid overhead irrigation. Plant resistant varieties like Shanty F1.
classes.preventionRw: Koresha imbuto zemejwe zidafite indwara. Kora guhindura ibihingwa (uruziga rw'imyaka 3). Usige umwanya uhagije (cm 60 hagati y'ibihingwa).
classes.care: Monitor plants daily during rainy season. Maintain good airflow by pruning lower leaves. Mulch around base to prevent soil splash. Harvest promptly when fruit is ripe.
classes.careRw: Kurikirana ibihingwa buri munsi mu gihe cy'imvura. Komeza umuyaga mwiza ukata amababi yo hasi. Shyira ibyatsi hafi y'umushinge.

classes.explanation: Leaves appear normal in color and texture with no signs of spots, wilting, or pest damage.
classes.explanationRw: Amababi aragaragara neza mu ibara no mu buryo nta bimenyetso by'utudomo, gucurika, cyangwa ibyonnyi.
classes.treatment: No treatment needed. Continue routine monitoring and good agricultural practices.
classes.treatmentRw: Nta muti ukenewe. Komeza kurikirana no gukoresha uburyo bwiza bwo guhinga.
classes.prevention: Keep balanced nutrition, avoid overhead watering, and scout weekly for early symptoms.
classes.preventionRw: Komeza indyo ihagije, wirinde kuhira hejuru, kandi usuzume buri cyumweru kugira ngo umenye kare ibimenyetso.
classes.care: Maintain consistent watering at the base, stake plants if needed, and remove only yellowed lower leaves.
classes.careRw: Komeza kuhira ku mushinge, tega ibihingwa nibiba, kandi ukure amababi ya kigina gusa.

classes.explanation: Early blight (Alternaria solani) causes concentric ring spots on older leaves, often with a yellow halo.
classes.explanationRw: Early blight (Alternaria solani) itera utudomo tw'uruziga ku mababi makuru, akenshi hamwe n'igitare cy'icyera.
classes.treatment: Apply registered fungicides per label; improve airflow; remove heavily infected foliage.
classes.treatmentRw: Shyira imiti yemewe ukurikije ibisobanuro; teza umuyaga; ukure amababi menshi yandujwe.
classes.prevention: Rotate crops, use clean seed tubers, and avoid prolonged leaf wetness.
classes.preventionRw: Hindura ibihingwa, koresha ibirayi by'indabyo, wirinda ko amababi ahagarara ameze nabi.
classes.care: Fertilize appropriately; irrigate at soil level; destroy crop debris after harvest.
classes.careRw: Shyira ifumbire neza; uhira ku butaka; usenye ibisigarira by'isarura.

classes.explanation: Orange-yellow powdery lesions on leaf undersides are typical of coffee leaf rust (Hemileia vastatrix).
classes.explanationRw: Utudomo tw'umuhondo tw'ibumbe ku mababi hasi ni bimenyetso bya rust ku kawa (Hemileia vastatrix).
classes.treatment: Use extension-approved fungicide programs; prune for penetration; follow local regulations.
classes.treatmentRw: Koresha gahunda y'imiti yemewe; sasa kugira ngo imiti ingane; ukurikize amategeko yo mu karere.
classes.prevention: Plant resistant cultivars where available; improve shade and nutrition management.
classes.preventionRw: Shinga ibihingwa byihariye nibiboneka; teza igicucu no gucunga ifumbire.
classes.care: Monitor after rain; remove fallen infected leaves from under trees when advised.
classes.careRw: Kurikirana nyuma y'imvura; ukure amababi yandujwe hasi y'ibiti nimbi byifuzwa.

classes.explanation: The image could not be matched with high confidence. Try a clearer photo of the affected leaf, closer and in natural light, or consult a local extension officer.
classes.explanationRw: Ifoto ntishobora guhuza n'ukuri guhanitse. Gerageza ifoto yizewe y'ikibabi cyangiritse, hafi, mu mucyo wa kare, cyangwa uvugane n'umukozi w'ubufasha mu buhinzi.
classes.treatment: Avoid guessing treatments. Seek expert advice before applying chemicals.
classes.treatmentRw: Wirinda gutunga umuti utazi. Shakisha inama y'impuguke mbere yo gukoresha imiti.
classes.prevention: Regular scouting and good field hygiene reduce surprises; keep records of symptoms.
classes.preventionRw: Gusuzuma buri gihe no kwita ku isuku byo ku murima byagabanya ibibazo; andika ibimenyetso.
classes.care: Isolate suspicious plants if possible and monitor spread; note weather conditions when symptoms appeared.
classes.careRw: Shyira ku ruhande ibihingwa bitewe amakenga nimbishoboka; kurikirana; andika imvura n'ikirere.
